builder_capability.marketplace_reason: No official MiMo Code marketplace contract was verified; the module uses documented native config, skills, agents, and instruction surfaces.

runtime_launch.project_config_discovery: disabled by manager-owned MIMOCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1 while preserving managed MIMOCODE_CONFIG_DIR skills
runtime_launch.claude_compatibility_loaders: disabled by manager-owned Claude flags and MIMOCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_IMPORT=1
runtime_launch.external_skills: disabled for external .claude/.agents/.codex/.opencode scans; managed native skills still load from MIMOCODE_CONFIG_DIR
runtime_launch.external_plugins: config-declared external plugins disabled by MIMOCODE_PURE=1; known unmanaged project extension paths are rejected before launch
runtime_launch.managed_config_dir_launch_closure: unknown files under MIMOCODE_CONFIG_DIR are rejected before launch so configured skills.paths and hook scans cannot expand beyond projected nddev-builder content
runtime_launch.external_telemetry: disabled by manager-owned MIMOCODE_ENABLE_ANALYSIS=0 independently of share: disabled

command_policy.json_argparse_errors: invalid commands, missing required arguments, and type errors return rc 2 with JSON stdout and empty stderr when --json is present

transaction_policy.lock: persistent product global.lock handoff for canonicalization; mutating commands atomically publish no-replace and acquire a persistent canonical-target external bootstrap flock; read-only inspection uses existing canonical bootstrap lock when present or a product-held no-create path when absent; target-internal flock is persistent only for mutating lifecycle commands
transaction_policy.external_lock_root: fixed-system-temp-root-product-uid marker pool containing monotonic global.lock plus mutating target-command canonical markers and pre-existing read-only markers

external_lock_persistent.product_anchor: monotonic global.lock once durably published by mutation; read-only cold path must not create it
external_lock_persistent.read_only_status_plan_software_status: cold no-anchor reads create no anchors; seeded reads use existing global.lock and existing target marker when present; absent targets do not create target-specific external markers

transaction_policy.read_only_cold_exception: cold zero-anchor read is the only target-observation exception before external coordination; it inspects the existing bootstrap product directory without creating or repairing, fails closed on product-absent canonical target anchors or publication aliases, and retries/fails closed if product or target anchor state changes during the read
transaction_policy.published_anchor_rollback_exception: complete validated product and canonical target anchors are monotonic rendezvous objects after the final-path publication commit point and are never unlinked by ordinary lifecycle cleanup or rollback
transaction_policy.hardlink_publication_alias_recovery: mutating openers lock the final anchor before parent mutation, remove exactly one bounded same-dev-inode machine-named publication alias, fsync the parent, and revalidate final path binding with nlink=1; read-only shared openers fail closed without recovery when nlink is not 1 or a publication alias is present; unknown or multiple hardlinks fail closed
transaction_policy.internal_lock_persistent: mutating commands only; read-only inspection commands do not create target-internal lock graph
transaction_policy.pre_lock_target_observation: none; only lexical absolute-target validation may precede the stable external lifecycle lock
transaction_policy.rollback_exact_object_graph: path presence, kind, directory/file topology, bytes, sizes, modes, inode identity, and modification times for in-scope target, control, lock, backup, and software paths
transaction_policy.rollback_strategy: rename-held undo material preserved until lifecycle postconditions pass and immutable postcommit cleanup journal reaches final-path no-replace publication
transaction_policy.precommit_recovery_intent: complete durable authority under .nddev-mimocode-recovery/NDDEV-MIMOCODE-RECOVERY.<pid>.<time>.json is published before every visible rollback, stage, recovery, backup, software, or cleanup source move; it binds canonical target, fixed recovery parent, bounded relative source/stash/generated paths, created directory candidates, and exact object graph records
transaction_policy.precommit_recovery_read_only: read-only commands fail closed without recovery when pre-commit recovery state or publication aliases are present; mutating commands recover exact same-inode aliases and restore-or-complete only under exclusive target coordination
transaction_policy.postcommit_cleanup_journal: immutable complete no-replace journal at .nddev-mimocode-cleanup/NDDEV-MIMOCODE-CLEANUP.json; it binds canonical target, fixed cleanup parent, bounded relative tombstones, kind, uid, mode, nlink, dev+ino, size, mtime, and tree digests; read-only commands validate and report only, while mutating commands recover one exact publication alias and drain before active changes
postcommit_cleanup_publish_order: rename preserve roots to final tombstones
transaction_policy.cleanup_pending_result: valid post-commit cleanup failure returns rc 0 with top-level cleanup_pending true and bounded non-path cleanup_pending_entries; malformed, incoherent, unknown, or over-bound cleanup state exits rc 2 without mutation
transaction_policy.setup_update_scope: existing managed setup/profile content only; software update uses update-cli
transaction_policy.setup_update_noop: true no-op only when no cleanup_pending state exists and current managed bytes already match the current build for the recorded setup_id/profile_id
transaction_policy.setup_update_backup: creates a target-bound backup only when update changes managed setup files
transaction_policy.setup_update_postcondition: verifies exact desired managed bytes after mutation and restores exact pre-state on failure
transaction_policy.backup_physical_topology: exact recorded files plus exact ancestor directories only; unrecorded files, unsupported path kinds, and empty extra directories are rejected
transaction_policy.backup_cleanup_postcondition: retired and recovery backup pools are promoted into the immutable postcommit cleanup journal after desired backup state is verified; valid drain failures report cleanup_pending instead of rollback-success, and malformed cleanup state fails closed
transaction_policy.same_uid_no_sandbox_boundary: Deliberate same-UID tampering outside the managed no-sandbox process boundary is not claimed to be prevented.

software_install.source: official XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-Code release assets with SHA-256 digests plus verified official installer in --binary mode
software_install.linux_product_scope: Ubuntu desktop/server share the canonical ubuntu-glibc-* product host IDs and are checked by structured os-release ID=ubuntu plus glibc before network, stage, or runtime; ubuntu_version_floor is null because upstream publishes no official floor.
